name: Axom AI helmet detection
publisher: Axom AI (Axom AI Technologies), Guwahati, Assam, India
author: Samarjit Kashyap
what_it_is: Computer vision system that finds motorcycle riders in phone videos and CCTV streams, decides helmet or no helmet per person, and alerts on Telegram, a dashboard and an Android app.
model: Ultralytics YOLOv8s fine-tuned (classes: helmet, no_helmet); COCO YOLOv8s finds motorcycles; YOLOv8n-cls head-crop classifier
runs_on: CPU, no GPU needed (desktop Intel Core i3: about 1.4 analysed frames per second)

measurements.claim: Recall on held-out CCTV frames before and after CCTV fine-tuning
measurements.data: HELMET dataset (Myanmar traffic cameras, CC BY 4.0), clips not used for training

measurements.claim: Share of bare-headed riders alerted by the live CCTV worker
Recall on night-style frames (model not yet trained on night images)

limits: Training data is daytime; night recall is 0.34 on night-style frames (night training not done yet)
Turbans are not in the training data
Test footage is from Myanmar traffic cameras; results differ per camera
Screening tool: a person should review each alert

licences.data: CC BY 4.0 and MIT datasets (HELMET dataset: CC BY 4.0)
